summary: Configured node1 with 512 MiB of zstd-compressed zram swap. It starts automatically at boot with priority 100, preferred over disk swap at priority -2. Reboot persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Activated /dev/zram0 with 512 MiB capacity and zstd compression.
Corrected the unit’s boot ordering and verified no ordering-cycle messages remain.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed full recovery.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap
evidence.summary: Post-reboot output shows /dev/zram0 using zstd with a 512 MiB disk size and active as swap.
Post-reboot swapon output shows zram priority 100 versus /dev/vda3 priority -2.
The service is enabled under multi-user.target and recovered active after reboot; the current-boot journal records successful zram creation and activation.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 7bb01663-3a26-4a9e-bcc4-cacbe07f7703; the reboot was acknowledged and connectivity dropped; node1 returned with boot ID b8ae22ed-427f-4eb0-8339-1ce2a130637f and healthy zram/disk swap state.
